description: Return the arccosine, in radians from 0 to #pi, of the double value. A value outside -1.0 to 1.0 gives NaN (an error under #compile strictDouble). A NaN argument gives NaN. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: #compile strictDouble, and the result would be NaN from an argument that is not NaN
